659c099b6e5f4abd.description: About the Role alfanar Electric is seeking an Authorization Manager to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves managing and maintaining the Delegation of Authority (DoA) across the organization, ensuring alignment between business processes, access controls, and governance policies. The Authorization Manager will ensure that operational authorities are designed, assigned, and monitored effectively to support secure, compliant, and efficient business operations. Key Responsibilities Support the design, review, and enhancement of Delegation of Authority frameworks in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Coordinate and follow up on DoA approvals, updates, and implementation to ensure effective governance and accountability. Serve as the primary point of contact for end-user inquiries related to delegated authorities within the assigned business scope. Analyze existing and new business processes to define and align appropriate authorization and approval requirements. Develop, maintain, and update operational authority matrices aligned with approved processes, procedures, and coding structures. Ensure delegated authorities and access permissions are clearly defined, accurately assigned, and controlled in line with approved delegations. Review and assess risks associated with authorization design, access permissions, and the effectiveness of Delegation of Authority controls. Implement and monitor control measures to mitigate segregation of duties (SoD) and access-related risks. Analyze the utilization of granted authorizations and permissions, recommending adjustments or restrictions where necessary. Prepare and maintain documentation of authorization risk assessments, mitigation actions, and approved risk acceptance decisions. Act as the designated Role Manager in accordance with alfanar’s GRC policy, ensuring compliance with internal control and governance requirements. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of user access rights, authorizations, and role assignments. Produce periodic reports on authorization effectiveness, utilization, and compliance for management review. Support internal and external audit activities by providing required documentation, evidence, and validation of authorization controls. Managerial Accountabilities Recruit, recognize, and cultivate high performers to create a robust second line of management. Address low performance through guidance or necessary action. Ensure fair treatment of subordinates, with performance as the primary assessment criterion. Take full responsibility for operations and deliverables, adhering to company guidelines. Anticipate problems and implement proactive prevention steps. Make timely and appropriate decisions. Deliver required results in a timely manner, meeting quality and cost standards. Make a tangible difference in the area of operation and exceed business expectations. Transform corporate goals into business plans, and monitor their performance. Provide periodic work progress reports and control budgets for optimum cost efficiency. Develop the organizational structure according to current and future requirements. Develop and coordinate written systems, policies, and procedures, seeking automation opportunities. Ensure a safe, secure, and legal work environment as per standard regulations. Qualifications and Experience 6-10 years of relevant experience. Proficiency in navigating IT solutions relevant to the job and business. Ability to adapt to new techniques, technologies, management structures, and business models. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires a commitment to quality as a prime competitive advantage and adherence to health, safety, and environmental standards.

655b4044bf68cf9f.description: About Teef Najd Group Teef Najd Group is seeking an experienced Procurement Engineer to join their team. This full-time role involves managing procurement activities within the construction and contracting sector, focusing on efficiency and quality. Role Overview The Procurement Engineer will be responsible for overseeing all procurement functions, from supplier engagement to material delivery. The role requires a professional with a strong background in construction procurement, capable of ensuring timely and cost-effective acquisition of materials while upholding quality standards. Key Responsibilities Manage all procurement activities related to construction and contracting projects. Negotiate effectively with suppliers to secure favorable terms and pricing. Evaluate quotations thoroughly to ensure competitive and quality-driven selections. Ensure the timely delivery of all required materials to project sites. Maintain high standards of material quality and cost efficiency throughout the procurement process. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in procurement, with a preference for experience within the construction industry. Demonstrated experience in supplier management, price negotiation, and quotation evaluation. Required Skills Good knowledge of construction and finishing materials. Strong communication, organizational, and time management skills. Proficiency in English and Microsoft Office applications. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time Procurement Engineer position at Teef Najd Group.

657d67ca23d41086.description: About the Role Esnad Contracting is seeking a Planning Engineer to join the Project Controls team. This full-time, site-based position is located in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and is integral to a major infrastructure project. The role focuses on maintaining project schedules, monitoring progress against baselines, and identifying potential delays to facilitate timely corrective actions. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain baseline and working schedules using Primavera P6, updating them to reflect actual progress and forecast completion dates. Track planned versus actual progress and prepare weekly and monthly reports covering key milestones, critical path activities, and schedule variances. Prepare look-ahead schedules, analyze delays, and collaborate with the project team to develop recovery plans. Coordinate resource and cost loading activities with the Cost Control team. Work with site teams, procurement, and subcontractors to verify progress and incorporate delivery and execution constraints into the schedule. Support schedule submissions to the Consultant or Project Management Consultant (PMC) and prepare supporting documentation for Extension of Time (EOT) claims. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. At least 5 to 10 years of planning and scheduling experience, including significant involvement in large-scale construction or infrastructure projects. Required Skills Proficiency in Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and Excel. Working knowledge of progress measurement and earned value management principles. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English are essential for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time, site-based position within a project controls team, focusing on a major infrastructure project in Jeddah.

65e3f3232f257fbb.description: About Jezoor General Trading & Contracting Company Jezoor General Trading & Contracting Company is an established commercial real estate firm managing offices, retail/commercial properties, and warehouses across Saudi Arabia. The company is seeking a dedicated Procurement and Contracts Officer to join its team in Al Khobar, Eastern Province, working full-time. The Role of Procurement and Contracts Officer The Procurement and Contracts Officer will manage sourcing, supplier relationships, service contracts, and purchasing controls for operating properties and development projects. This hands-on role involves leading day-to-day procurement activities, obtaining competitive quotations, and negotiating commercial terms. The position reports administratively to Finance & Administration while maintaining independent sourcing and documentation controls, coordinating closely with Engineering, Property Management, and Finance teams. Key Responsibilities Manage the complete procurement cycle, including purchase requests, RFQs, bid comparisons, negotiations, approvals, purchase orders, and supplier follow-up. Source and evaluate contractors for various property services such as HVAC, electrical, plumbing, elevators, fire and life safety, cleaning, and security. Coordinate tendering and purchasing for construction, refurbishment, and capital expenditure projects in collaboration with the Engineering department. Maintain an approved supplier database, conduct vendor due diligence, perform performance reviews, and carry out periodic market-price comparisons. Prepare, maintain, and track service agreements and purchase contracts, including expiry dates, renewals, warranties, and key commercial terms. Ensure all purchases comply with company budgets, approval limits, competitive quotation requirements, and conflict-of-interest controls. Collaborate with Engineering to verify technical specifications and work completion, while Finance independently verifies invoices and processes payments. Maintain accurate procurement records and purchase orders within the company ERP system (Odoo or similar). Prepare periodic reports on procurement spending, cost savings, supplier performance, outstanding orders, and upcoming contract renewals. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline. Approximately 4–7 years of relevant procurement and contracts experience, preferably within commercial real estate, facilities management, construction, or building maintenance. Practical experience in preparing RFQs, evaluating quotations, negotiating with suppliers, and managing service contracts. Familiarity with technical building-service categories and contractor procurement processes. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP/purchasing systems; experience with Odoo is an advantage. Strong communication, negotiation, documentation, and organizational skills. Ability to work from the company office in Al Khobar. Preferred Attributes Experience supporting multiple commercial buildings or a portfolio of operating properties. Ability to independently manage purchasing while coordinating effectively with technical and finance teams. Demonstrated strong ethics, attention to detail, cost awareness, and commitment to transparent procurement processes.

65ea2e60900f60f8.description: About the Role HR International is seeking an IT Service Desk Support Specialist to join their team in Al Jubail. This full-time role serves as the primary point of contact for all IT-related incidents, service requests, and inquiries, ensuring efficient resolution and escalation. Key Responsibilities Act as the first point of contact for all IT-related incidents, service requests, and inquiries received via phone, email, or the ticketing system. Log, categorize, prioritize, and track all tickets within the ITSM tool, adhering to ITIL Incident and Request Management processes. Ensure that all tickets are resolved or escalated within the agreed Service Level Agreement (SLA) timelines. Core Duties Perform first-level troubleshooting for a range of issues including hardware, software, network, and application problems. Escalate unresolved incidents to Level 2/3 support or other relevant technical teams, ensuring complete documentation is provided. Contribute to root cause analysis and problem management initiatives to help reduce the occurrence of recurring incidents. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this position should possess 5-10 years of experience in an IT service desk or support role. A strong understanding of ITIL processes, particularly Incident and Request Management, is essential. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, offering an opportunity to work within a professional IT support team at HR International. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

65edfa7a34688280.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Principal Landscape Engineer / Landscape Architect to lead landscape design and technical delivery for a significant luxury high-end development in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience in the field. Key Responsibilities Lead the development of landscape design and ensure its technical delivery. Coordinate landscape design elements with architecture, civil works, infrastructure, irrigation, lighting, water features, and MEP systems. Review specifications for grading, drainage, planting, irrigation, hardscape, furniture, lighting, and materials. Ensure compliance with environmental, sustainability, irrigation, water conservation, and authority requirements. Maintain the project’s landscape vision, sense of place, guest experience, and luxury standards. Coordinate plant selection, nursery requirements, soil preparation, maintenance, and long-term landscape performance. Review landscape mock-ups, samples, planting trials, and site installations. Coordinate with specialists in water features, pools, lighting, horticulture, and irrigation. Review contractor and supplier submissions for technical compliance. Support value engineering and constructability reviews. Conduct site inspections and monitor the quality of landscape installation. Support testing, commissioning, establishment, maintenance, and handover processes. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the landscape team. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in landscape design and technical delivery. Demonstrated experience in leading landscape design for major high-end developments. Strong understanding of environmental, sustainability, and authority requirements related to landscape projects. Proficiency in coordinating with various engineering and design disciplines. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time position within a project-focused team. The successful candidate will work on a major luxury development, contributing to its overall landscape vision and technical execution.

6541b2277bfe45a5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ألفية العربية التجارية عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وتسوية الحسابات، وتقديم خدمة عملاء فعالة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، ويوفر فرصة للمساهمة في العمليات المالية اليومية للشركة. نظرة عامة على المسؤوليات يتولى موظف الصندوق مسؤولية التعامل مع جميع جوانب المدفوعات النقدية وبطاقات الائتمان، بدءًا من عد وتسجيل المبالغ في بداية الوردية وحتى تسوية النقدية مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهايتها. كما يشمل الدور تحديث قوائم الأسعار وتلبية طلبات العملاء المتعلقة بقوائم الشراء. المهام الرئيسية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، مع ضمان توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقدًا أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو الطرق الأخرى المعتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بمهنية وتلبية رغباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب العمل ضمن فريق في بيئة ديناميكية تركز على خدمة العملاء وإدارة العمليات المالية بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين على التقديم.

6514bc7ef23d706c.description: About Red Sea Global Red Sea Global is a developer of pioneering regenerative tourism projects. Its subsidiary, Red Sea Coastal Trading Company, specializes in supply chain and logistics, ensuring the seamless delivery of materials, equipment, and services across its portfolio. This subsidiary manages end-to-end supply chain operations, including procurement support, transportation coordination, inventory, warehouse management, and last-mile logistics to remote destinations along the Red Sea coast and beyond. The team focuses on efficiency, reliability, and environmental responsibility, aligning with Red Sea Global’s commitment to sustainability, operational excellence, and local value creation. Position Overview The Senior Coordinator Transport and Distribution supports the Transport & Distribution Department by gathering, cleansing, sorting, and aggregating data from various sources. This role involves consulting on business information and decision-making needs, as well as designing, planning, coordinating, and managing data to generate output reports and presentations. Key Responsibilities Collaborating with shipping companies to ensure timely and safe arrival of shipments. Coordinating the flow of materials and products through distribution centers or warehouses. Maintaining accurate inventory records to identify overstocks or shortages. Reviewing orders to confirm correct fulfillment and inclusion of all necessary information. Planning routes and schedules for transport vehicles to meet delivery deadlines. Coordinating with suppliers or vendors to arrange deliveries of materials or products to clients. Developing new methods for storing or transporting goods to reduce costs or increase efficiency. Reviewing shipping costs to determine the most cost-effective method of transporting goods. Providing logistical support to other departments for events such as trade shows. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to gather, cleanse, sort, and aggregate data from various sources. Experience in designing, planning, coordinating, and managing data for report generation. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a dynamic environment focused on supporting large-scale regenerative tourism projects.

6548a530e2a932a5.description: About the Role Keeta is seeking a Pharmacy Category Manager to lead end-to-end procurement and category management for pharmaceutical and health products. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role involves managing a broad range of products, including over-the-counter (OTC) medications, prescription drugs, health and nutritional supplements, personal care items, and medical devices. Role Context and Scope The Pharmacy Category Manager will operate within the regulatory frameworks of the SFDA, MOH, and UAE MOHAP. A key aspect of this role is building a pharmaceutical supply chain optimized for on-demand retail, which includes establishing relationships with manufacturers and primary distributors. The position also supports the replenishment needs of dark stores, characterized by high-frequency, small-batch orders requiring rapid turnaround times. Category and Sourcing Strategy Develop a procurement framework for pharmaceutical and health-related categories, with tiered management across segments such as OTC, health supplements, medical devices, personal care, and maternal & infant health. Formulate a tiered supplier strategy, including direct sourcing from manufacturers or authorized agents, engagement with primary distributors, and utilization of emergency distribution channels. Establish a category ROI model, incorporating metrics such as gross margin, inventory turnover, sell-through rates, out-of-stock rates, and losses due to product expiration. Supplier Management and Negotiation Expand and maintain a supplier database compliant with SFDA/MOHAP regulations, including verification of qualifications, authorization chains, and product registration certificates. Lead RFP/RFQ processes, negotiating terms such as pricing, rebates, payment cycles, return/exchange policies, management of near-expiry stock, and exclusive supply arrangements. Implement a supplier tiering system and define Service Level Agreements (SLAs) covering metrics like On-Time In-Full (OTIF) delivery rates, damage rates, and compliance/contractual breach rates. Manage dual-sourcing or backup supply sources to prevent stockouts, with a particular focus on cold-chain products and items under restricted distribution. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in procurement and category management, specifically within the pharmaceutical or health product sector. Demonstrated understanding of regulatory frameworks such as SFDA, MOH, and UAE MOHAP. Proven ability to build and manage supply chains, including supplier negotiation and relationship management. Application Process Candidates who meet the outlined qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

656a378a6c6dbd20.description: About Qiddiya | القدية and the Role Qiddiya | القدية is seeking a Manager Roads Maintenance AG to oversee the inspection, maintenance, and operational safety of the assigned road network and associated assets within Qiddiya City. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on translating operational priorities into risk-based maintenance programs to ensure the road infrastructure remains safe, reliable, and serviceable for all city users. Role Overview The Manager Roads Maintenance AG will manage various aspects of road infrastructure, including contractor oversight, defect resolution, and road safety improvements. This involves coordinating roadworks, emergency maintenance, and the handover of new road assets. The position requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field, dedicated to maintaining high standards of road network integrity and operational readiness. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement preventive, corrective, and emergency road maintenance programs based on asset condition and operational risk assessments. Manage inspections of pavements, footways, crossings, signs, markings, barriers, and associated road drainage systems. Oversee maintenance contractors, work orders, and service levels, ensuring quality and timely completion of tasks. Lead defect prioritization and corrective actions, coordinating road safety inspections and engineering improvements. Prepare maintenance budgets, forecasts, and procurement scopes, while monitoring expenditure and managing maintenance backlogs. Coordinate permits, lane closures, diversions, and emergency call-outs with relevant operational teams and authorities. Support new-road handover processes and operational readiness, maintaining accurate asset records and reporting on maintenance performance. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of experience in roads maintenance or a related field. The position requires a strong understanding of road network management, including inspection protocols, maintenance strategies, and operational safety standards. Experience in contractor management and budget oversight is essential. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Qiddiya City development. The role involves working with various operational teams and external authorities to ensure the efficient and safe operation of the road network. Application Process Qiddiya | القدية invites qualified candidates to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

65c5ac9bd207c6aa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة أريس للتشغيل والصيانة عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على أعمال وأنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتطوير إجراءات العمل، ومعالجة المشكلات التشغيلية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال وأنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم العمل والأولويات وقدرات الموظفين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق الأنشطة مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات الصلة لضمان التكامل. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ثم متابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها، وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الخدمات العامة أو دور إشرافي مماثل. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق الأنشطة وتحديد المهام بفعالية. مهارات في إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول المناسبة. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. إتقان إعداد وتقديم وحفظ التقارير. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق مؤسسة أريس للتشغيل والصيانة. تتطلب الوظيفة التزامًا باللوائح التنظيمية والعمل ضمن بيئة ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في مؤسسة أريس للتشغيل والصيانة.

65d761b0fd31d481.description: الوصفخبرة لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في مجال المبيعات داخل السوق السعودي. خبرة في أحد المجالات التالية: الأثاث، الأخشاب، المطابخ، الأبواب، الديكور أو المجالات ذات الصلة. الأفضلية لمن لديه خبرة في مبيعات B2B ومبيعات المشاريع. امتلاك علاقات وقاعدة عملاء مع شركات المقاولات، شركات التصميم الداخلي، الفنادق، المطورين العقاريين والاستشاريين. القدرة على استقطاب عملاء جدد وفتح حسابات ومشاريع جديدة. خبرة في التسعير، إعداد عروض الأسعار، التفاوض، العقود، ومتابعة المبيعات حتى إغلاق الصفقة والتحصيل. معرفة جيدة بمنتجات الأثاث والأخشاب، مع القدرة على فهم المخططات والمواصفات والكميات بشكل أساسي. مهارات قوية في التواصل والتفاوض، مع مظهر مهني مناسب للتعامل مع العملاء. إجادة اللغتين العربية والإنجليزية. رخصة قيادة وسيارة. يفضل وجود سجل واضح

6510fb5cefb0f023.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أبراج العاليات للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى صيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية. متابعة تنفيذ الأعمال الكهربائية لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات. إعداد مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص الأعطال في الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة جامعية في الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الكهربائي ومخططات شبكات النقل والتوزيع. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإدارة برامج الصيانة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق شركة أبراج العاليات للمقاولات في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمتطلبات المشاريع الهندسية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

6565167529b404d7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة المجال العربي عن فني أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بما في ذلك الدوائر وعناصر التحكم والآلات. دراسة المخططات لتحديد نوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين والحرفيين الآخرين في عمليات تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية. اختبار الأجهزة الإلكترونية بعد التركيب لضمان التقيد بالمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. إجراء الفحوصات الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال فني الأجهزة الإلكترونية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الفنية. معرفة قوية بتركيب واختبار وصيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص، ويسهم في دعم العمليات الفنية وأنشطة البحث والتطوير. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الإفصاح عنه وسيناقش خلال عملية التوظيف.

657d20c82f8ac0c5.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a dedicated Forklift Operator to join their team in Dammam. This full-time role involves the safe and efficient operation of a forklift, with a strong emphasis on adherence to operational procedures and daily safety inspections. The Operator will be responsible for handling materials, including billets and production scrap, while maintaining strict safety standards. Key Responsibilities Operate the forklift with extreme care and safety, strictly following established safe operation procedures. Conduct daily physical inspections of the forklift, checking engine oil, hydraulic oil, and engine coolant before operation. Implement all possible safety measures when handling billets. Drive slowly and avoid over-speeding, especially when carrying loads. Understand the Safe Working Load (SWL) of the forklift prior to operation and exercise extra caution when lifting weights at or near its SWL. Report any abnormalities immediately to the mobile workshop or direct supervisor. In the supervisor's absence, park the forklift safely, remove the key, and tag out the steering. Unload billets from trucks safely and stack them systematically with the assistance of helpers. Shift billets and other materials as per Foreman/Supervisor instructions. Display billets for cutting and charging to the mill, and charge them to the mills at the charging grid according to Supervisor instructions. Remove production scrap from various mill areas and dispose of it in the scrap yard as required and per superior instructions. Perform all tasks in accordance with ISO and CARES requirements. Safety and Compliance Understand and adhere to organizational Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) policies. Follow all safety instructions related to assigned jobs. Report damaged Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), unsafe machines, or equipment to the concerned staff. Maintain provided PPEs in good, workable condition. Avoid any horseplay and misuse of safety devices, equipment, and welfare facilities. Report any accidents, near misses, or hazardous conditions to the responsible party. Attend all planned safety training sessions. Exercise the right to refuse any unsafe work. Qualifications and Experience Primary School education. 1-2 years of experience in forklift operation. Work Type This is a full-time position within Al Tuwairqi Group.

650af78b9b11f75d.description: About the Role Abdullah A. Al-Barrak & Son Co. is seeking an Electrical (SMP) professional to join their team in Dhahran, Eastern Province. This full-time role involves the installation, inspection, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electrical equipment and systems within various industrial facilities, including Oil & Gas, petrochemical, and power plants. The position requires 11 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical systems to ensure safe and reliable operations. Inspect, test, and troubleshoot electrical transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, and motor control centers (MCC). Support the installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical substations and associated equipment. Conduct testing and maintenance of protection relays and electrical distribution systems. Troubleshoot and maintain Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems, Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), and motor starters. Inspect and maintain Low Voltage (LV), Medium Voltage (MV), and High Voltage (HV) electrical equipment. Perform various electrical tests, including insulation resistance testing, Megger testing, and HIPOT testing. Inspect, troubleshoot, and maintain power generators, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), and MOV actuators. Utilize electrical testing equipment to identify faults and verify equipment performance. Ensure compliance with electrical safety procedures, hazard recognition practices, and applicable NEC standards. Prepare maintenance reports, document inspection findings, and maintain accurate technical records. Coordinate with maintenance and engineering teams to resolve electrical issues and minimize equipment downtime. Required Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 11 years of experience in electrical installation, inspection, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Demonstrated ability to work with electrical systems in Oil & Gas, petrochemical, or power plant facilities. Proficiency in using electrical testing equipment. Strong understanding of electrical safety procedures and NEC standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dhahran, Eastern Province, involving work within industrial settings such as Oil & Gas, petrochemical, and power plant facilities. The role requires coordination with various maintenance and engineering teams.

65b2a44595ec9124.description: About the Role Nahdi Medical Co. is seeking an Applications Reconciliation & Data Integrity Manager to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah Region. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and reliability of enterprise data flows across core business systems, including ERP, POS, payment gateways, banking platforms, and third-party applications. The manager will own the end-to-end governance, design, and operational effectiveness of financial and operational data integrations and reconciliation processes. Role Purpose and Impact The Applications Reconciliation & Data Integrity Manager ensures that all financial data movements are fully reconciled, audit-ready, and compliant with internal controls, IFRS requirements, and IT governance standards. This position acts as the enterprise authority for data reconciliation, integration controls, and data integrity assurance across applications, supporting critical business processes such as financial close, reporting, taxation, and operational analytics. Key Accountabilities Own and govern the enterprise-wide integration and reconciliation framework across all financial and operational systems. Ensure end-to-end integrity of data flows between ERP, POS, payment gateways, banking systems, and third-party applications. Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of integration architecture, reconciliation models, and data validation rules. Oversee all financial reconciliation processes including sales-to-GL, bank reconciliation, POS-to-ERP reconciliation, AP/AR, VAT, inventory valuation, and intercompany transactions. Ensure timely detection, investigation, and resolution of data discrepancies, integration failures, and posting errors. Define and enforce data integrity standards, reconciliation policies, and control frameworks aligned with internal audit, ITGC, ISO 27001, and IFRS requirements. Act as the escalation point for critical data integrity and integration issues impacting financial close and business reporting. Ensure readiness and accuracy of month-end and year-end close processes by validating all financial integrations and reconciliations. Drive automation of reconciliation and integration monitoring using SQL, ETL tools, APIs, and data validation scripts. Develop and maintain dashboards and KPI reporting for data integrity, reconciliation accuracy, and system performance. Lead governance of integration tools and platforms (*, Oracle ARCS, middleware, ETL solutions), ensuring optimal usage and control. Collaborate with Finance, Treasury, Tax, Internal Audit, and IT teams to ensure alignment on data integrity and reconciliation standards. Support audit processes by providing evidence, documentation, and traceability of reconciliation controls and integration flows. Own Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical data and integration incidents and ensure corrective/preventive actions are implemented. Continuously enhance data reconciliation and integration capabilities through adoption of automation, AI-based anomaly detection, and data observability tools. Maintain documentation of integration architecture, reconciliation rules, control matrices, and data lineage. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Work Environment and Schedule This is an indoor role, with 100% of work performed within an office environment. The work schedule is 5 days a week, with 2 days off. Working hours are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, including a one-hour break.

65d8071de7119f59.description: About the Role Saudia Dairy & Foodstuff Company (SADAFCO) is seeking a Credit Controller to join their team in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves assisting the Credit Control Manager in maintaining and enhancing the company's credit control system to ensure timely collections, working closely with the Sales department. Key Responsibilities Review and update company credit control policies and procedures in liaison with sales and finance management, ensuring adherence by all departments. Provide periodic financial reporting to management, including regional cash collection forecasts, actual collections, and aged debtor analysis. Assist the sales department in analyzing and preparing collection forecast reports to facilitate proper follow-up on pending collections. Manage outstanding sales balances, contact customers before payments become overdue, and initiate necessary proceedings to resolve outstanding debts. Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customers through regular visits. Perform rebate calculations and apply new Business Development Agreement (BDA) changes to monthly bookings. Conduct timely reconciliations of customers' accounts to ensure completeness of records and efficient collection processes. Support the Credit Control Manager by providing all required information related to Accounts Receivable (AR) for external audits. Review and evaluate customers' credit limits to ensure accuracy based on their historical payment behavior. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in a relevant credit control or finance role. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

65e4d5c88523a43c.description: About Ferring * Ferring * is a global pharmaceutical company focused on scientific advancements in reproductive and women’s health, gastroenterology, and urology. The company emphasizes collaboration and diverse contributions to achieve its mission of helping people build families and live better lives. This role is based in Riyadh and is a full-time position. The Role of Medical Representative The Medical Representative is responsible for promoting Ferring products to healthcare professionals in Riyadh, aligning with established marketing strategies. This role involves building and maintaining professional relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring accurate product information dissemination, and gathering market intelligence. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Visit healthcare professionals to promote Ferring products according to marketing strategies, frequency, and approved impact numbers for each doctor segment. Build and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals and other stakeholders. Participate in local, regional, and international scientific congresses as determined by the company. Classify doctors and stakeholders based on segmentation and targeting criteria, proposing additions, changes, or removals from existing files. Track prescription habits, assess product perception, verify prescription potential, and evaluate influence on other doctors. Provide accurate and updated product information to healthcare professionals, utilizing marketing materials, clarifying doubts, handling objections, and highlighting product advantages over competitors. Obtain market information regarding product concerns, competitors, and the effectiveness of marketing strategies and materials. Gather intelligence on public tenders, competitor product launches, cost containment measures, and health authority instructions, transmitting this information to relevant parties. Conduct market surveys for current and new products. Propose territory activities such as congress invitations, doctor lectures, and clinical sessions to promote products in compliance with ethical standards and ensure return on investment. Organize approved proposals within the assigned budget and manage the budget to ensure return on investment. Follow up on product consumption in pharmacies and hospitals, and monitor sales performance within the assigned territory. Inform the line manager of daily activities and future plans in a timely manner, and submit expense reports or other requested documentation. Maintain detailed records of all contacts and visit details, including database management. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience as a Medical Representative, demonstrating a strong ability to engage with healthcare professionals and manage a sales territory effectively. A commitment to ethical standards and a results-oriented approach are essential for success in this role. Working at Ferring * Ferring * fosters an inclusive and diverse workplace, providing equal opportunities and mutual respect for all employees. The company encourages collaboration and values diverse contributions to drive organizational and professional growth. Application Process Candidates whose mission and vision align with Ferring *'s objectives are encouraged to apply. The salary for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

65046c664809b5fc.description: About the Role UCC Holding is seeking a Project Engineer - Fit-Out to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves overseeing and coordinating all interior fit-out activities for a luxury hotel construction project. The role focuses on ensuring high-quality execution of architectural finishes, FF&E, MEP coordination, and specialty installations, while adhering to project schedules, budgets, and safety standards. Key Responsibilities Manage and supervise all fit-out construction activities for luxury hotel guest rooms, suites, public areas, restaurants, ballrooms, spas, and back-of-house facilities. Coordinate with architects, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, and project stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution. Review project drawings, shop drawings, specifications, material submittals, and RFIs. Monitor site progress and ensure fit-out works are completed in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, and hospitality brand standards. Coordinate closely with MEP, structural, architectural, and FF&E teams to avoid clashes and interface issues. Conduct regular site inspections and quality audits to ensure superior workmanship and compliance with project requirements. Track project schedules and identify potential delays, implementing corrective actions where necessary. Manage subcontractors and ensure adherence to project timelines, safety requirements, and quality standards. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports. Attend coordination meetings with clients, consultants, operators, and project management teams. Support testing, commissioning, snagging, de-snagging, and handover processes. Ensure compliance with Saudi Building Code, project specifications, international hospitality standards, and HSE regulations. Monitor material procurement and delivery schedules to support construction activities. Qualifications and Experience Extensive experience in delivering high-end hospitality projects. A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a similar role. Demonstrated ability to manage and coordinate complex fit-out activities. Project Focus This role is specifically for a prestigious luxury hotel construction project, requiring a focus on high-quality architectural finishes, FF&E, MEP coordination, and specialty installations. Location and Work Type The position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time engagement. Salary details for this role are not disclosed. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply.

658c4f72f0050154.description: About the Role InterContinental Hotels Group is seeking a Sales Executive to join their team. This full-time position focuses on developing client relationships and driving new business to increase hotel revenue and promote services. The role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new business opportunities to achieve sales targets. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential clients. Promote the hotel’s guest rooms, meeting facilities, and food & beverage services. Conduct sales calls, client visits, and site inspections to generate business. Follow up on sales leads, proposals, and client enquiries. Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify new business opportunities. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess a passion for building client relationships and driving new business. A background of 0-1 years in a sales-related role is required for this position. 65d41c8799216ccf.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن فرع شركة عبدالعالي العجمي عن حاجتها لمهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في بقيق، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. سيقوم المهندس المدني بدراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على التنفيذ لضمان مطابقة المواصفات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بشكل دقيق. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع لضمان مطابقة جميع المواصفات والمعايير. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل البيانات الطبوغرافية والجيولوجية. مهارات قوية في إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية والمخططات الهندسية. القدرة على الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية وضمان الجودة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق عمل في فرع شركة عبدالعالي العجمي بمدينة بقيق، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع حسب متطلبات المشروع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

65d931cc13fcb76e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قادة الفعالية للخدمات التجارية عن مهندس تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تلبية احتياجات العملاء من الأجهزة والبرمجيات، وتطوير الأنظمة، وتشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة احتياجات العملاء من الأجهزة الحاسوبية وبرمجياتها وتلبيتها بفعالية. متابعة وتقييم عملية جمع وتحليل البيانات، وتطوير أساليب التحليل والتصميم بناءً على التقييم. البحث عن أحدث وسائل وأدوات البرمجة والفحص والتركيب المناسبة، ومراقبة دورة تطوير البرمجيات. تطوير وفحص وتركيب التجهيزات الحاسوبية والبرمجيات لضمان الأداء الأمثل. تشخيص أعطال التجهيزات الحاسوبية والبرمجيات ومعالجتها بكفاءة. تطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية العمل. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية المستمرة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وعرض نسب تقدمها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال تقنية المعلومات أو دور مشابه. فهم قوي لاحتياجات الأجهزة والبرمجيات الحاسوبية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الفنية وتقديم الحلول المناسبة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التواجد في الموقع للتعامل مع التجهيزات والبرمجيات بشكل مباشر. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

652d009a725dbcc5.description: About the Role Diyar United Company is seeking an ICS/OT Information Security Architect to join their team in Al Khafji. This full-time position involves designing, implementing, and overseeing cybersecurity architecture and controls within Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT) environments. The role requires a professional with 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Design and oversee cybersecurity architecture specifically for ICS/OT environments. Develop and implement OT security controls, policies, standards, and procedures. Assess OT/ICS networks, systems, and infrastructure to identify cybersecurity risks and vulnerabilities. Apply recognized OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and ISO/IEC 27001. Ensure alignment with applicable Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) OT cybersecurity requirements, including NCA OTTCC. Collaborate with IT, OT, engineering, infrastructure, and operations teams to implement secure architectures. Support risk assessments, security reviews, vulnerability management, incident response, and cybersecurity improvement initiatives. Review and guide the implementation of network segmentation, firewalls, monitoring, access control, and other OT security controls. Provide technical guidance on OT cybersecurity architecture, solutions, and projects. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in information security, with a focus on ICS/OT environments. Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing cybersecurity architecture for industrial control systems. Proficiency in developing and applying OT security controls, policies, and standards. Familiarity with relevant cybersecurity frameworks such as IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and ISO/IEC 27001. Understanding of Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) OT cybersecurity requirements, including NCA OTTCC. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khafji, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment focused on securing critical industrial control systems.

The role focuses on planning and executing maintenance programs to maintain smooth equipment and facility operations within the steel, metal fabrication, PEB, or heavy industrial manufacturing sectors. Key Responsibilities Lead a diverse maintenance team, ensuring optimum performance and technical excellence. Plan and execute preventive and corrective maintenance programs to ensure smooth equipment and facility operations. Ensure compliance with HSE regulations and promote a strong culture of safety. Manage maintenance budgets, spare parts inventory, and capital assets. Oversee installation, commissioning, and upgrades of machinery and utilities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Production, Procurement, and HSE. Generate regular reports, analysis, and recommendations for operational improvements. Minimum of 10 years of experience in industrial maintenance, with at least 5 years in a leadership role. Strong industry background in steel, fabrication, heavy manufacturing, or related sectors. Proficiency in MS Office, SAP or CMMS tools, and equipment lifecycle planning. Certified Maintenance Manager (CMM) or equivalent certification is preferred. Work Environment This role offers an opportunity to work within one of the region’s top industrial groups in a dynamic and collaborative environment. The position is based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. 65c4a26d7b2e3422.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مراجعة وتنسيق أنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتطوير إجراءات العمل، ومعالجة المشكلات التشغيلية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف مراقب الخدمات العامة إلى الإشراف على عمليات الخدمات العامة، وتحسين الأداء، وتنمية مهارات الموظفين. يشمل ذلك تحديد المهام والواجبات، وتطوير برامج العمل، واقتراح حلول للمشكلات، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الدورية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال وأنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم العمل والأولويات وقدرات العاملين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق الأنشطة مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات الصلة. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ومتابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق الأنشطة التشغيلية. مهارات في إعداد وتطوير إجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع موظفي الخدمات العامة والوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى لضمان تحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة سراكو.

65da405d2bc21856.description: About the Role NOZOM is seeking a Cybersecurity Architecture Expert to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Oversee the development and implementation of cybersecurity systems. Review security designs to ensure alignment with technical and business requirements. 65ffd6714480a2c5.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع صافيه لمياه الشرب المعباه عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. سيقوم المحاسب بإعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية لضمان دقة السجلات المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات. مهارات في إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. القدرة على تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في التعامل مع البيانات المالية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحليل الإيرادات والنفقات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المالية وحفظها. مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة المستندات والسجلات المحاسبية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصنع صافيه لمياه الشرب المعباه. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم النمو المهني. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. نشجع المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

65a69125ff2c0dcf.description: Admissions and Parent Experience Executive (Talent Pool) Cognita Schools is building a talent pool for future Admissions and Parent Experience Executive opportunities in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 65c473a8d185ebe6.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب المستوى للاستشارات الهندسيه عن مراقب جودة للانضمام إلى فريقه في الباحة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث يركز على ضمان الالتزام بمعايير الجودة في مراحل التصنيع المختلفة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع عينات تصنيع من مراحل متعددة ضمن عملية التصنيع، بما في ذلك المنتجات قيد التصنيع والمنتجات النهائية. إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة على عينات المنتجات، والتحقق من مدى التزامها بمعايير الجودة المحددة، وتوثيق النتائج التي يتم التوصل إليها بدقة. تحديد مصادر العيوب المحتملة، وتقديم التوصيات الفعالة للتخفيف من آثارها، وتحديث سياسات وإجراءات الجودة وفقاً لذلك. الحفاظ على الخبرات الفنية وتحديث المعرفة المستمرة حول أحدث اتجاهات القطاع واللوائح الحكومية ذات الصلة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال مراقبة الجودة أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق معايير وإجراءات الجودة. مهارات جيدة في جمع البيانات وتوثيق النتائج. المهارات والكفاءات الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع المهام الموكلة. مهارات تحليلية لتحديد المشكلات واقتراح الحلول. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. مهارات تواصل فعالة لتوثيق النتائج وتقديم التوصيات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مكتب المستوى للاستشارات الهندسيه بمدينة الباحة. سيعمل مراقب الجودة ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان أعلى مستويات الجودة في جميع العمليات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. ندعو المرشحين المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

Help Nutrili understand which partnerships are truly valuable and which are not worth continuing. 5. Reporting & Performance Tracking Maintain a weekly partnerships and retail growth tracker. Report on partner pipeline, meetings, proposals, activations, leads, sampling, sell-through feedback, reorder opportunities, and blockers. Prepare post-activation reports including objective, cost, audience reached, leads collected, sales or reorder impact where available, customer feedback, and next steps. Track partnership outcomes against clear KPIs, not just activity. Provide leadership with clear recommendations on where Nutrili should invest more time, budget, and team effort. What This Role Owns Strategic partner support Partner relationship management Retail activation planning and execution In-store sampling and staff education coordination Wellness, corporate, clinic, gym, and community partnerships Partnership pipeline management Partner feedback and customer insight reporting Activation performance reporting Reorder opportunity identification Weekly partnerships tracker You will work closely with these teams, but your role is to build and grow partnerships that create measurable brand and commercial value. Success Looks Like Strategic partners are better supported after listing. Store teams understand Nutrili products and can explain them clearly. Requirements Saudi National Network in Riyadh across retail, wellness, beauty, fitness, clinics, hotels, or corporate wellness is a strong plus. 3–6 years of experience in partnerships, business development, trade marketing, retail account management, brand activations, or key account growth. Experience in wellness, beauty, supplements, FMCG, pharmacy, consumer health, hospitality, fitness, or premium lifestyle brands is preferred. Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills. Commercial mindset — able to connect partnerships to revenue, sell-through, leads, customer acquisition, and brand growth. Strong execution skills and comfort managing activations end-to-end. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment. Strong organization and follow-up discipline. Comfortable using Google Sheets, trackers, reports, and basic performance dashboards. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong understanding of premium consumer brands and Saudi customer behavior. Willingness to travel for partner meetings, retail visits, activations, and events. You may be a strong fit if you have worked in: Beauty or wellness retail partnerships Consumer health brand activations Premium brand partnerships Retail partner success Corporate wellness partnerships Fitness or lifestyle partnerships Strategic account management for a consumer brand You should be someone who can say: “Here is the partner pipeline, here is the opportunity, here is what we activated, here is what converted, here is what we learned, and here is what we should do next.” Why Join Nutrili Join one of the GCC’s fastest-growing wellness brands. 65b27313eae4d188.description: About the Role Olayan Saudi Holding Company is seeking a Sales Engineer for the interior fit-out project business in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on originating, qualifying, and converting fit-out opportunities with end clients, consultants, developers, and main contractors. The Sales Engineer will manage each opportunity from initial engagement through award, execution support, and final account closure. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities The Sales Engineer is accountable for achieving assigned order-intake, revenue, and gross-margin targets, ensuring the technical and commercial integrity of all submitted proposals. Responsibilities include: Identifying, qualifying, and developing interior fit-out project opportunities within the assigned territory and target segments. Building and maintaining a qualified pipeline through engagement with end clients, developers, consultants, architects, and main contractors. Tracking project announcements, design activity, and tender releases to secure early engagement and influence specifications. Representing the company at client meetings, site walkthroughs, industry events, and pre-tender briefings. Technical and Commercial Proposals This role involves preparing comprehensive technical and commercial proposals, ensuring compliance and client satisfaction. Key tasks include: Conducting site surveys and reviewing architectural and interior drawings, specifications, and bills of quantities to establish accurate scope. Translating client requirements into costed technical solutions in coordination with design and estimation teams. Preparing, reviewing, and submitting technical and commercial proposals within client deadlines. Complying with organizational commercial policies, delegation of authority, and contract review and approval procedures. Developing cost-benefit analyses and value-engineering alternatives to support client decision-making while protecting project margin. Ensuring all submissions comply with tender requirements, standard terms, and applicable regulations. Maintaining accurate and current pipeline, forecast, and opportunity data in the designated sales system. Negotiating commercial terms, finalizing sales agreements and contracts, and closing orders within delegated authority. Ensuring timely invoicing and collection of receivables, and supporting the resolution of overdue accounts. Acting as the commercial point of contact for variations, change orders, and scope clarifications during execution. Supporting milestone sign-offs, handover documentation, snagging closure, retention release, and final account settlement. Escalating delivery, quality, cost, or scope risks to the Sales Manager and Projects team promptly with proposed courses of action. 65b9e6da99e28862.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اعالي الطموح للخدمات اللوجستية عن مراقب حركة مركبات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، بالمنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مراقبة حركة المركبات وتوثيق البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بها، بالإضافة إلى توضيح التعليمات الصادرة من الإدارة العليا بما يضمن الامتثال للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية لمراقبة حركة المركبات، وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. المشاركة في تنظيم جداول مواعيد وصول ومغادرة المركبات حسب المسارات المحددة، ومراقبة مدى التزام السائقين بها. مراقبة الأعمال والعمليات المتعلقة بالمركبات، بما في ذلك تدوين محتوياتها عند مغادرة المحطات، وحمولتها، وأوزانها، وأرقام سائقي المركبات، ووقت مباشرتهم العمل ونهايته. مراقبة مدى الالتزام بكافة السياسات والإجراءات المتبعة في عمليات حركة المركبات. تدوين كافة التعليمات والأوامر والقرارات الصادرة في السجل الخاص بها، والعمل على إرسالها وتوضيحها للسائقين. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بمراقبة حركة المركبات أو الخدمات اللوجستية. القدرة على تدوين البيانات والمعلومات بدقة واهتمام بالتفاصيل. فهم جيد للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة لحركة المركبات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة وقدرة على إدارة الوقت. مهارات تواصل فعالة لتوضيح التعليمات للسائقين والتعامل مع الإدارة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتوثيق المعلومات. الالتزام بالتعليمات والقرارات الصادرة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة اعالي الطموح للخدمات اللوجستية في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بمراقبة العمليات اليومية لحركة المركبات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم مراجعة جميع الطلبات بعناية.

6519f4d4d2897140.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة لاند آند روف عن مهندس إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى وضع وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع المتكاملة، وإدارة التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشاريع بدقة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الجداول الزمنية وإدارة التكاليف والموارد لضمان إنجاز المشاريع بكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع وتنفيذ خطة متكاملة للمشروع، والتحكم في التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة من حيث البنود والأزمنة، مع التعرف على الجوانب الفنية المحددة لتنفيذ العمل. تقدير الأوقات والمواعيد النهائية للمشروع، وإعداد الجداول الزمنية باستخدام البرامج والتطبيقات المخصصة لتطوير جداول العمل، والتي تحدد المهام المجدولة وفترات تنفيذها والموارد المتاحة لكل منها. إدارة التكلفة والموارد المطلوبة لإنجاز المشروع، بما في ذلك تخطيط وإدارة الموارد البشرية والمادية والمعدات والتقنيين، وتقدير التكلفة المتوقعة بالتعاون مع مهندسي التكاليف والمهندسين المعنيين بالتنفيذ، ومتابعة الإنفاق. إعداد وتطبيق خطة علاقات مع جميع الأطراف ذات الصلة بالمشروع، وتوفير أساس لتوزيع المعلومات ونشر حالة مراحل المشروع. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على وضع خطط المشاريع وتنفيذها بفعالية. إتقان استخدام برامج وتطبيقات إعداد الجداول الزمنية للمشاريع. مهارات قوية في إدارة التكاليف والموارد. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة لاند آند روف، حيث تتاح له الفرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع هندسية متنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

656df5eaa1f3fdba.description: About the Role Savills Middle East is seeking a Cost Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 65d8c74419e500bb.description: We are looking for an E-Commerce & Marketplace Operations Executive to manage the day-to-day operations of our e-commerce store and marketplaces, including Zid, Amazon, Trendyol, and other sales channels . The role will be responsible for the full order lifecycle — from receiving and processing orders to fulfillment, shipping, delivery, inventory coordination, and resolving operational issues. The ideal candidate should be highly organized, hands-on, and capable of coordinating effectively between the warehouse, branches, customer service, marketplaces, and logistics partners. Key Responsibilities E-Commerce & Order Fulfillment Manage and monitor daily orders through the Zid Dashboard . Review and process incoming orders and ensure they are ready for fulfillment. Manage the complete order lifecycle from order receipt to picking, packing, shipping, and delivery. Coordinate Picking, Packing & Order Fulfillment with the warehouse team. Monitor pending and delayed orders and take immediate action to resolve issues. Handle operational issues related to missing items, incorrect orders, cancellations, exchanges, and returns. Ensure orders are processed and shipped within the required turnaround time. Marketplace Operations Manage daily operations across Amazon, Trendyol, and other marketplaces . Process and monitor marketplace orders according to each platform’s requirements and SLA. Ensure order and shipment statuses are updated accurately. Monitor marketplace cancellations, returns, delayed orders, and fulfillment issues. Coordinate inventory availability across the website and marketplaces. Identify and resolve operational issues that may negatively impact marketplace performance. Coordinate issues related to SKUs, barcodes, product mapping, and inventory synchronization . Inventory & Branch Coordination Monitor inventory availability across the e-commerce store and marketplaces. Coordinate with the warehouse and branches to ensure stock availability. Manage and follow up on stock transfers and replenishment between the warehouse and branches . Monitor low-stock and out-of-stock items and escalate when replenishment is required. Identify and resolve discrepancies between physical and system inventory. Ensure accurate SKU and barcode mapping across all sales channels. Shipping & Logistics Operations Manage daily operational coordination with courier and logistics partners. Ensure orders are assigned to the appropriate shipping provider. Monitor AWB creation, shipment pickup, delivery, and shipment status . Follow up on delayed, failed, or returned shipments. Coordinate with couriers, warehouse, and customer service teams to resolve delivery issues. Monitor recurring shipping problems and escalate them when required. Operations Control & Reporting Ensure accurate and timely order status updates across all systems and marketplaces. Conduct daily follow-ups on pending, delayed, and exception orders. Coordinate between E-Commerce, Marketplaces, Warehouse, Branches, Customer Service, and Logistics . Prepare operational reports covering order fulfillment, delays, cancellations, returns, and operational errors. Identify recurring operational issues and implement corrective actions. Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to increase efficiency and reduce manual work. Requirements 2–4 years of experience in E-Commerce Operations, Marketplace Operations, Order Fulfillment, or a similar role. Hands-on experience in order processing, inventory management, fulfillment, and logistics operations. Experience with Zid is highly preferred. Experience with Amazon Seller Central and other marketplaces is preferred. Good understanding of Order Fulfillment, Inventory Management, and Marketplace Operations . Familiarity with SKU management, barcodes, inventory synchronization, and stock transfers . Good knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets . Strong organizational, follow-up, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage a high volume of orders and coordinate across multiple teams. Strong attention to detail and ability to take ownership of daily operations. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-Time Fulfillment Rate Order Accuracy Marketplace SLA Compliance Pending & Delayed Orders Order Cancellation Rate Inventory Accuracy Stock Availability Return & Failed Delivery Rate Issue Resolution Time Overall Operational Efficiency

65b3776d7d444a21.description: ERAM Talent is seeking an experienced Research & Development (R&D) Engineer – Beverages . The successful candidate will be responsible for developing innovative beverage formulations, improving existing products, conducting pilot trials, and supporting factory-scale production. This role requires strong expertise in beverage formulation, sugar reduction technologies, and functional ingredients. Key Responsibilities Develop and formulate new beverage and liquid products based on market trends and customer requirements. Improve existing beverage formulations to enhance taste, quality, nutritional value, and production efficiency. Lead sugar reduction initiatives using alternative sweeteners while maintaining product taste, texture, and stability. Develop formulations incorporating functional ingredients such as vitamins, minerals, proteins, and fibers. Conduct laboratory trials, bench-top formulations, and pilot-scale testing. Lead factory scale-up activities and support the successful transition from laboratory development to commercial production. Evaluate thermal processing methods, including pasteurization, to ensure product quality and ingredient stability. Select and evaluate raw materials and identify suitable alternatives when required. Provide technical support during new product launches and production trials. Train production teams on processing requirements for new formulations. Troubleshoot manufacturing issues such as sedimentation, phase separation, flavor degradation, and color changes. Work closely with Quality Assurance to ensure compliance with food safety and regulatory standards. Conduct shelf-life studies, stability testing, and maintain complete technical documentation. Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related discipline. 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience in the Beverage or Liquid Food Manufacturing industry. Proven experience in beverage formulation and product development. Strong knowledge of functional ingredients and their stability in liquid applications. Demonstrated experience in sugar reduction projects and alternative sweeteners. Experience with pilot plant trials and factory-scale production. Sound understanding of pasteurization, beverage processing, and food safety standards. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent documentation and communication abilities. Preferred Experience Experience in juice, flavored beverages, dairy beverages, functional drinks, or similar liquid food products. Exposure to cost optimization and product reformulation projects. Familiarity with international food safety and quality management systems.
